Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and accepted an incorrect death year for Léo Joannon (1996) from a search snippet while ignoring multiple credible sources on the same results page indicating 1969 (e.g., IMDb, Prabook). This failure to reconcile conflicting sources led to the wrong comparison and final conclusion that the Excursion Train director died later; the correct outcome is that John Sturges (1992) died later than Léo Joannon (1969), i.e., Bad Day at Black Rock.
